name: Kobayakawa Ayane
source:
She is a voracious reader with a quiet personality. She is the heir to the Kobayakawa Group, but the group itself is going downhill.

She commutes to her school in Tokyo by train every morning.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/choumanin/index.html]official site[/url]]
